description: A clean three-locale catalog in which every file carries a unique marker key (Only.En, Only.De, Only.Fr) alongside a shared Common.Greeting. The markers are the point: because loadFromClasspathResources takes the locale from the caller, the only way to observe WHICH resource landed under WHICH locale is a per-file key. Serves the multi-locale, locale-key, conflict and resource-path clauses. Verified to load from the filesystem as de/en/fr with three distinct primary languages, so no tiebreakers are required and Strings construction succeeds.
